On December 4th our Youths cross country championship was held as usual on Wimbledon Common and David Bradford proved to be the winner of the "Overseas Cup" with Richard Dorman second and Brian Marmion third.

Youth Club Champion David Bradford rounds the final turn into Lauriston Road in the 5¾ mile road race. His strong running, particularly over the last mile, marks him as a force to be reckoned with in all future senior club races.
Les Davies made his debut in Belgrave colours with 2nd in the triple and long jumps and is a most welcome addition to our ranks, whilst David Bradford came close to his best in the 1500m.
